text:
laura: Quick idea 3 staggered micro-cohorts (10d) + a commitment ladder: light (async), standard (sync + small integration), deep (reserved capacity + SLA).
josh: Love the ladder 3 sets expectations up front and helps prioritize ops.
priya: Screener should be tiny: tier preference, estimated tokens/day, compliance needs, contact + willingness to run a short integration test. Keep 4 fields.
marco: Ops note: reserved pool only for deep tier (7d provisioning). Standard = hosted with soft-priority routing and spike protection.
legal-kate: On traces use "share redacted request/response traces for debugging" + optional DPA for sensitive customers. I'll post legal blurb by EOD.
laura: Proposed success gates: >=4 engaged partners per cohort, >=2 validated integration pilots, >=4 actionable GH items with repro/spec, and no P1 regressions vs baseline.
priya: Feedback loop: light = async Notion pulse; standard = weekly 60m sync + pulse; deep = twice-weekly sync + dedicated channel + SLO dashboard. Save prompts/golden outputs to GH for auto-eval.
infra-bot: Auto-eval harness available; runtime pairing Monday 9am PT.
marco: We'll emit partner-tagged metrics (tokens/day, p50/p95 latency, error-rate) to a DP dashboard; need an owner.
josh: I'll take dashboard ownership initial sprint.
laura: Owners summary: priya (recruit + prompts), josh (copy + dashboard), marco (ops & routing), legal-kate (contracts). I'll draft landing page and screener tonight.
priya: Also add an optional "light-to-standard" upgrade path mid-cohort if partner wants deeper engagement. Helps funnel.
laura: Agreed. Next steps: legal blurb, invite draft, infra pairing. Target pilot start in 3 weeks.
